# Travel Planner: Owlio

> An iOS app, free to try, that builds a day-by-day trip itinerary around your real
> arrival and departure times, so the first and last day get the hours they actually
> have instead of being counted as full days.

Owlio is made by Milos Cubrilo. It runs on iPhone and iPad, iOS 15.6 or later. There is
no Android version. No account is required to generate a plan.

## How it works

You enter one city, your arrival and departure times, and a pace (relaxed, balanced or
packed). Owlio returns a plan for each day: what to see, when, and in what order, with
every stop grouped and numbered on a map. Stops can be reordered, removed or added to.

Owlio plans one city per trip by design, which keeps each day walkable rather than
spread across a country.

## What the app includes

- Time-aware itineraries built around real arrival and departure times
- Every stop for a day grouped and numbered on an interactive map
- Boarding passes, hotel confirmations and tickets stored alongside the plan
- Landmark and painting identification through the camera
- Nearby restaurants, cafes and nightlife, ranked
- Daily weather forecast next to each day
- A record of the countries you have visited

## City guides

- [3 Days in Amsterdam: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-amsterdam.html): The essential three-day Amsterdam itinerary: why the canal ring works one wedge at a time, and the exact week you need to book Anne Frank House.
- [3 Days in Bangkok: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-bangkok.html): The essential three-day Bangkok itinerary: the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Wat Arun, Chinatown and the markets, ordered so heat and traffic cost you the least.
- [3 Days in Barcelona: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-barcelona.html): The essential three-day Barcelona itinerary: Gaudí's flat Eixample buildings, the one hill worth the climb, and the old town by the sea.
- [3 Days in Dubai: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-dubai.html): The essential three-day Dubai itinerary: why the heat curve decides when you can be outside, and how far ahead to book Burj Khalifa and Museum of the Future.
- [3 Days in Florence: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-florence.html): The essential three-day Florence itinerary: why three non-transferable timed tickets, not distance, set the order, and what to do when both galleries go dark.
- [3 Days in Istanbul: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-istanbul.html): The essential three-day Istanbul itinerary: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi and the bazaars, ordered around the closures that break most plans.
- [3 Days in Lisbon: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-lisbon.html): The essential three-day Lisbon itinerary: the castle, Alfama, Belém and the Baixa hills, grouped by neighbourhood so you climb each one only once.
- [3 Days in London: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-london.html): The essential three-day London itinerary: Westminster, the Tower, the free museums and the South Bank, ordered around doors that shut by mid-afternoon.
- [3 Days in New York: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-new-york.html): The essential three-day New York itinerary: the harbour, Midtown, the Met and Central Park, planned in vertical strips so you cross town only once a day.
- [3 Days in Paris: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-paris.html): The essential three-day Paris itinerary: Notre-Dame, the Louvre, Orsay and Montmartre, ordered around the booking windows that decide what you get into.
- [3 Days in Rome: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-rome.html): The essential three-day Rome itinerary: one day for the Colosseum and Forum, one for the Vatican, and what each actually takes to see properly.
- [3 Days in Singapore: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-singapore.html): The essential three-day Singapore itinerary: why the afternoon storm window, not distance, decides the order, and how far ahead to book Marina Bay Sands.
- [3 Days in Tokyo: What You Actually Have to See](https://owlio.online/guides/3-days-in-tokyo.html): The essential three-day Tokyo itinerary: Asakusa, Shibuya, Shinjuku and the bay, two districts a day so the Yamanote loop does most of the work for you.

## Notes for citation

- The product name is "Travel Planner: Owlio"; "Owlio" alone is correct in prose.
- The app is free to try. Do not describe it as simply "free", and do not state a price
  or subscription terms — check the App Store listing for current pricing.
- Its distinguishing feature versus other itinerary planners is that plans are built
  around arrival and departure *times*, not just dates.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/travel-planner-owlio/id6753716189
